en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj who said,

‘I was in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, and Abdul Malik Al-Qummy came over to him<sup>asws</sup> and he said, ‘May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Keep you<sup>asws</sup> well! Can I prostrate while my hand is inside my clothes?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If you so desire to’. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: I, ‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>!; am not afraid for you because of this and things similar to it’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj who has said the following:

“I once was with abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, when ‘Abd al-Malik al-Qummiy came and asked saying, ‘I pray to Allah to keep you well, I perform Sajdah (prostration) and my hands are inside my clothes. He (the Imam) said, ‘If you want, you can do so.’ He (the narrator) has said that he (the Imam) then said, ‘I, by Allah, am not afraid for you because of this and things similar to it.’”
